sources.entry: Parseur - Parseur is a powerful data entry software that automates text extraction from emails, PDFs, and other documents, enhancing productivity by eliminating manual data entry. #freemium

summary.name: Parseur
summary.one_liner: Parseur is an AI data extraction service that pulls structured data from PDFs, scans, emails and images and sends it to spreadsheets, apps and databases.
use_cases: Extract invoice and PO data into accounting systems
Parse shipping and delivery documents for logistics
Turn incoming emails into CRM records
Replace manual copy-paste of document data
summary.what_it_does: Parseur uses AI to read PDFs, scans, emails and images and returns the data as clean, consistent structured output. Users name the fields they want in plain English, and the page says the AI extracts them without templates or layout-specific setup. Documents can be uploaded via drag and drop, forwarded to a dedicated email address, sent through an API, or connected through Zapier, Make, or n8n. Results can be downloaded as Excel or CSV or pushed directly to other apps. The page also describes a web app for operations teams and a developer API, plus audit-style logging and alerts for documents needing review.
notable: No template needed: plain-English field definitions work across layouts
EU-hosted infrastructure with GDPR, CCPA, PDPA compliance claims and SOC 2 Type II
Integrations with Zapier, Make, n8n plus a developer API
Free plan with 20 pages per month
caveats: HIPAA compliance is stated as in progress, not complete
Free tier is limited to 20 pages per month; higher volumes imply paid plans (details not on page)
Savings figures and uptime are company claims on the page, not independently verified
